title: The Azure Healer's Great Canon
summary: A canon for the healer of the azure schools on closing a gravely wounded body whole in one long radiant effort.

title: Treatise of the Twin-Court Physicians
summary: A treatise of two physicians working as one to hold a failing life and call it back at the edge of death.

title: The Basin of Unending Remedy
summary: A manual of the basin that never empties and pours healing qi over many wounded until the field is mended.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Wing Remedy
summary: A manual of sweeping the body clean of curse and rot with wing-wide strokes that leave no residue behind.

title: Canon of the River of Recovery
summary: A canon on rebuilding broken meridians and a wounded dantian with a river of qi that finds its old course.

title: The Monarch's Gentle Art
summary: A rare manual of gentleness taught only to those of the Monarch level whose full meridian network can bear its slow great work.

title: The Wind-Sworn Great Reckoning of Healing
summary: A reckoning for the wind-sworn healer that carries mercy to the wounded on a high steady gale.

title: The Canon of the Open Sky Remedy
summary: A canon of the open-handed remedy that hides nothing and calls a fallen life back under the bright sky.

title: Treatise of the Unbroken Oath of Mercy
summary: A treatise on the sworn oath of mercy that gives the healer strength to keep working long after others stop.

title: The Bearing Wind Restoration Compendium
summary: A compendium on cleansing taint with a steady wind taken on a fixed bearing so nothing foul stays in the air.

title: Manual of the Long Gale Recovery
summary: A manual of the long reaching gale that carries healing qi to the wounded across a wide and scattered company.

title: The Plateau Mender's High Art
summary: A rare high art of the Gale menders taught only at the Monarch level and spent on a single life.
